en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a quiet, tree‑lined urban street with a row of multi‑story residential or institutional buildings on the left. The nearest corner building has an arched entrance with steps, railings, and a round window above, plus a sculpted coat of arms or relief plaque on the façade. A woman in early 20th‑century clothing walks with a child along the sidewalk, and the unpaved street stretches into the distance with more historic buildings visible at the far end.
